review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: The complete 1536x1024 H6 plate was inspected independently.
review_views.notes: Open sea, delta, forest river, circular city, roads, port, fields, right-side rocky highland, and quiet corridors retain the required H5 arrangement.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The final RGB PNG was inspected at native 1536x1024 resolution.
review_views.notes: H4-like sepia, olive, dusty-blue water, and copperplate contrast are restored, but the city, port, forest, and rocky highland do not satisfy the strict orthographic symbol rules.

review_views.label: 25%縮小
review_views.evidence: H6 was downscaled to 384x256 with Lanczos and compared side by side with H5, H4, and Candidate B1.
review_views.notes: The macro layout remains legible and tonal contrast is stronger than H5, while the dark circular forest field and angular rocky field become conspicuous repeated textures.

review_views.label: 50%縮小
review_views.evidence: H6 was downscaled to 768x512 with Lanczos and compared side by side with H5, H4, and Candidate B1.
review_views.notes: Road, river, city, port, and field hierarchy remains readable; dense repeated canopy rings and peak-like rocky marks compete with quiet overlay corridors.

review_views.label: 200%拡大
review_views.evidence: All nine 512x341/342 regions were inspected at 200% pixel zoom.
review_views.notes: The scan confirms continuous networks and frame-free edges, but also widespread circular canopy stamps, angular peak/roof motifs, and residual city depth.

review_views.label: 400%拡大
review_views.evidence: Forest, rocky highland, circular city, port, and south coast were inspected in 384x256 crops at 400% pixel zoom.
review_views.notes: Forest marks resolve as dense outlined circles, the highland contains repeated triangular and roof-like glyphs, and the city keep, walls, towers, and port structures retain light/dark side cues.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: A complete 3x3 scan covered the full canvas without gaps at 200%.
review_views.notes: No text, watermark, frame, floating underside, missing required zone, broken network, or visible edge seam was found. Repetition and non-plan architectural cues recur across multiple regions.

review_views.label: H5形状参照との比較
review_views.evidence: H5 and H6 were compared side by side at 25% and 50%, with H6 additionally inspected at native, 200%, and 400%.
review_views.notes: H6 preserves H5's macro composition, but reintroduces triangular highland symbols and retains the city and port depth cues that the v6 prompt explicitly required it to remove.

review_views.label: H4素材・色調参照との比較
review_views.evidence: H4 and H6 were compared side by side at 25% and 50%.
review_views.notes: H6 recovers H4's darker sepia-olive material family, dusty-blue sea, and richer ink contrast without reproducing H4's large scenic relief, but it also inherits visually busy symbol textures.

review_views.label: Candidate B1画風との比較
review_views.evidence: Candidate B1 and H6 were compared side by side at 25% and 50%.
review_views.notes: H6 is substantially flatter than B1 and restores some copperplate richness, but its repeated circular and triangular glyph fields are more mechanical than B1's varied hand-inked terrain.

review_views.label: 外周・継ぎ目
review_views.evidence: All four outer edges and internal terrain transitions were inspected across overview and regional views.
review_views.notes: The image remains frame-free and visually continuable through all edges; no abrupt tile join or generation seam is visible.

review_views.label: 道路・河川ネットワーク
review_views.evidence: Roads, delta branches, the main river, city approaches, and road-river crossings were traced at native, 25%, 50%, 200%, and 400% views.
review_views.notes: Road and river systems remain continuous and distinguishable, including delta branches, bridge/crossing semantics, and routes reaching image edges.

review_views.label: ベクター重畳余白
review_views.evidence: Quiet corridors around the city, roads, fields, coast, and open water were inspected at 25%, 50%, and native size.
review_views.notes: Open water and principal corridors support overlays, but the forest and rocky glyph density would compete with small labels and thin vector strokes.

review_views.label: raw/final整合性
review_views.evidence: Raw and final files are both 1536x1024 RGB PNGs with SHA-256 86d61909913a3c6a402ae2c12211a79a2a15e755e98fba622fcb0e2d7bcfaaf6.
review_views.notes: The reviewed final is byte-identical to the raw generation.

immediate_failures.label: 文字・偽文字
immediate_failures.evidence: No text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, legend, compass, or scale bar was found in the overview or nine-region scan.

immediate_failures.label: 透かし・枠・現代物
immediate_failures.evidence: No watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, decorative corner, UI, or modern object appears.

immediate_failures.label: 浮島下面
immediate_failures.evidence: All islands and delta bars read as ordinary flat plan-view land with no floating underside, overhang, or detached cliff base.

immediate_failures.label: 側面・遠近法・方向光
immediate_failures.evidence: At 400%, the central keep has conical/raised form and asymmetric dark sides; the lower/right city wall and round towers show vertical facade shading, and port buildings, piers, and posts retain oblique depth cues.

immediate_failures.label: 必須構成の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: Open sea, delta, forest river, circular city, port, roads, fields, rocky highland, and quiet label corridors are all present.

immediate_failures.label: 道路・河川破断
immediate_failures.evidence: Roads and river channels remain traceable through crossings, delta branches, city approaches, the port, and image edges.

immediate_failures.label: 樹木・岩・記号の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: Large forest areas are filled with closely repeated outlined circular canopy stamps, while the right highland repeats triangular, peak-like, and roof-like angular glyphs; both patterns are conspicuous at 25%, 50%, 200%, and 400%.

immediate_failures.label: 目立つ端継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: No border, abrupt edge strip, internal tile join, or conspicuous discontinuity was found along any outer edge.

scores.label: Prompt構成・厳密平面性
scores.notes: The H5 macro composition is preserved and coastlines remain flat, but three explicit v6 corrections fail: city/port depth remains, circular canopy stamps persist, and triangular peak-like highland symbols return.

scores.label: 親画像・Candidate B1画風連続性
scores.notes: H6 successfully restores the H4/B1 sepia-olive, dusty-blue sea, parchment texture, dark ink hierarchy, and copperplate material richness while retaining H5's layout.

scores.label: 端部・継ぎ目連続性
scores.notes: The plate is frame-free, internally coherent, and visually continuable through all four edges.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: Palette and line treatment are materially more coherent than H5, but mechanically repeated forest/highland vocabularies and residual architectural depth break the intended flat GIS language.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Copperplate micro-detail and macrocontrast are restored across water, terrain, city, coast, and fields, although much of the terrain detail is carried by repeated glyphs rather than varied cartographic structure.

scores.label: 生成破綻・非反復性
scores.notes: No text corruption or seam is visible, but extensive circle-stamp vegetation and repeated triangular/roof-like rocky symbols are mechanical, prompt-prohibited artifacts across large areas.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Roads, rivers, fields, city approaches, open water, and principal corridors remain readable, but dense forest and highland patterns reduce small-label clarity compared with H5.

summary: H6 restores the darker H4/B1 palette, copperplate material richness, and macrocontrast while preserving H5's required composition, continuous networks, and clean edge behavior. It is not Golden-ready: 400% inspection confirms raised/side-lit city and port forms, large forest regions remain dominated by circular canopy stamps, and the right highland reintroduces repeated triangular and roof-like peak symbols explicitly forbidden by the v6 prompt.
required_changes: Redraw the central keep, city walls, towers, port buildings, piers, and posts as unshaded overhead footprints and centerlines with no cone, facade, vertical shaft, or light/dark side.
Replace the forest-wide circular canopy rings with irregular merged overhead canopy patches, branching clusters, broken edges, gaps, stipple, and varied sizes without cloned round stamps.

Replace every triangular, roof-like, peak-like, or convergent angular highland glyph with direction-neutral irregular chips, short disconnected marks, mottling, and non-repeating stipple while preserving the restored palette and network clarity.
